title: ADR-009 — Approval decision status is distinct from AgentRun status
summary: docs/adr/ADR-009-approval-decision-run-status.md · 原文保留历史日期；先学主课程，需要核查时再读。
html:
Status: Accepted during M6-A post-M5 review closure.

DENIED and EXPIRED are Approval decision outcomes, not additional AgentRun.status values. A denied or expired approval is consumed by the durable graph as a safe tool observation; the Run may complete normally or fail according to the surrounding graph. NEEDS_ATTENTION remains reserved for uncertain action outcomes and other reconciliation failures.

This keeps the M5-A database status constraint and deterministic evaluation semantics unchanged. M6 presents approval decision failures separately from action execution failures in the timeline; it does not reinterpret the underlying persisted status values.
